eyebrow: Measures that quote the mart, not reinterpret it
code:
SKUs At Risk of Stockout =
CALCULATE (
    COUNTROWS ( inventory_depletion_gold ),
    inventory_depletion_gold[is_at_risk_of_stockout] = TRUE
)

Avg Days of Supply =
AVERAGE ( inventory_depletion_gold[days_of_supply] )
caption: is_at_risk_of_stockout and days_of_supply arrive pre-computed from dbt -- DAX never recalculates either.

eyebrow: Validated by hand before one visual exists
code:
SELECT store_id, COUNT(*) AS at_risk_skus
FROM pinehurst_db.gold.inventory_depletion_gold
WHERE is_at_risk_of_stockout = TRUE
GROUP BY store_id
ORDER BY store_id;
caption: Matched row for row against the Power BI card before this went anywhere near Store Operations.
